caption: The drawing features a central, colored illustration of a wooden chest with dovetail joints at the corners, a flat lid, bracket feet, and a decorative brass keyhole escutcheon at the front center of the chest. The chest is rendered in varying shades of brown and golden yellow to represent wood grain and highlights. Above and to the right of the chest, there is a detailed line drawing of the brass escutcheon shown at actual size, colored yellow-gold and labeled "Actual Size (tracing)". In the lower left corner, a line drawing shows the chest in a straight-on front elevation view, with measured dimensions indicated as "Scale 1/8=1'", giving the size as 42 1/2 inches wide and 21 inches high. In the lower right corner, another line drawing displays a side view of the chest, also with measured dimensions of 18 1/2 inches deep and "Scale 1/8=1'". The layout is arranged on an off-white background with fine lines creating boxes for the additional details, and the name "K.Morris" is signed in the lower right corner.
title: Chest
